question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The princess firmly held the ______ in her hands.
solution:
The correct answer is "rein."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "rein"** might be used in the blank depending on the context or intended meaning.
 
• In this context, if we assume that the princess is holding something that symbolizes control, authority, or guidance, **"rein" **could be used metaphorically.
 
• The word **"rein"** is often associated with controlling and guiding horses, as in holding the reins to direct them. (घोड़े की लगाम, रास)
 
 
• **Example**: *This is a post that will give your talents full **rein**__.*
 
 
 
• When used metaphorically, it can imply control, authority, or influence over a situation.
 
• Therefore, if the princess is holding something that signifies her control or influence, **"rein"** would be a suitable word.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence: *The princess firmly held the __**rein**__ in her hands.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Rain: **the drops of water that fall from the sky. (वर्षा, बारिश)
 
• **Ran: **the past tense of run. It means to move using your legs, going faster than a walk. (दौड़ना (टाँगों के सहारे, चलने से अधिक तेज़ गति करना))
 
• **Reign: **(used about a king or queen) to rule a country. ((राजा या रानी का) किसी देश पर शासन करना)
